T-001.Title: Restructure the docs-security install into download, strict digest verification, then extraction, with the committed GITLEAKS_SHA256 env constant

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add a workflow-level env block to .github/workflows/release-governance.yml between the permissions block and the jobs key, holding exactly GITLEAKS_SHA256 with the binding comment that names the exact upstream artifact gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz, the v8.30.1 checksum-listing derivation with out-of-band confirmation, and the bump-together rule with the local install (tools/security_gate.py). IMPLEMENTATION GATE: the literal lowercase 64-hex digest is filled at implementation time only from the v8.30.1 release's published checksum listing and confirmed out-of-band (a second independent source, or a sha256 of the owner's locally installed gate archive of the same version); both raw derivations are recorded in the change bundle before merge; the digest is never fetched at runtime from the release channel it authenticates, and no implementation that cannot show its derivation is approval-ready. The reviewed diff of this change is the trust anchor for the literal value.

Replace only the "install pinned Gitleaks" step with the exact sequence pinned in the implementation notes: set -euo pipefail retained; download to a temporary file under RUNNER_TEMP via mktemp; curl -fsSL of the unchanged v8.30.1 linux_x64 URL with -o to that file; strict verification echo "$GITLEAKS_SHA256 $archive" piped only into sha256sum --check --strict - (two spaces between digest and path in the check line); tar -xzf of only the gitleaks binary to /usr/local/bin strictly after the check passes; rm -f of the temp file; gitleaks version as the unchanged post-extract smoke probe. The check and extraction stay separate statements so a mismatch exits nonzero before any extraction or execution and the exit status cannot be swallowed; the curl-piped-into-tar form no longer exists anywhere in the file.

Keep every other byte of behavior: job set, triggers, permissions (contents: read), concurrency, checkout pins and parameters, fetch base main, the scan step, and the governance, readiness and project-mirror jobs are untouched. Synchronize the file-local GRACE markup: VERSION 1.4.0 to 1.5.0; a dated 2026-11-21 CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for C-SEC-GITLEAKS-CHECKSUM; MODULE_CONTRACT SCOPE and DEPENDS minimally state the digest-verified pinned Gitleaks binary; MODULE_MAP and all other markup stay as-is.

T-002.Title: Pin the checksum contract in the governance tests with distinct red controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Extend tests/renderer/release-governance.test.js inside START_BLOCK_RELEASE_GOVERNANCE_TESTS, keeping all existing tests unweakened: a docs-security job slice and install-step slice are derived by the file's existing split style, and positive pins assert the GITLEAKS_SHA256 constant line matching a lowercase 64-hex shape in the workflow-level env, the bump-together binding comment naming the v8.30.1 linux_x64 artifact, the unchanged URL pin, the -o download to the temp file, the strict sha256sum --check --strict invocation, the ordering download before check before tar -xzf before gitleaks version, and the absence of any pipe-into-tar form in the docs-security job. Both the version string and the 64-hex constant are asserted present in the docs-security job source as one reviewed unit.

Add red controls that mutate only the checked-in workflow source string in memory (no tracked-file edits, no network, no runtime trust-material fetch) and reject each mutation with a distinct expectation: removing the GITLEAKS_SHA256 constant line is rejected as a missing digest constant; dropping --strict (or any non-strict or status-swallowing check form) is rejected as a non-strict check; moving the tar -xzf line above the sha256sum check line is rejected as extraction before verification. Note explicitly in the test comments that a well-formed but different 64-hex digest is deliberately not distinguishable by shape pins — digest truth is anchored by the reviewed diff and the recorded out-of-band derivation, never by a test-time fetch.

Synchronize the test file's local markup: VERSION 2.1.0 to 2.2.0 and a dated 2026-11-21 CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for C-SEC-GITLEAKS-CHECKSUM; no changes to any tools/*.mjs helper, test configuration or other test file.
